notes.title: 1.0.2 Small Changes
notes.content:
1.0.2 Changes:

-Added Controls to Pause Menu.
-Shed is now a safehouse.
-Added ambient lighting to Shed and Generator.
-Button on credits to go to main menu instead of a key press.

notes.title: Difficulty Update - 1.0.1
notes.content:
Difficulty Update!

This update makes the game harder, with the incorporation of Sanity.

Changes:
-Sanity system. having your flashlight off reduces your sanity.
-Siren Head is much faster.
-Siren head's AI is better.
-Fixed bugs relating to Siren Head's AI.
-Toggling the flashlight in the final chase works as intended.
-Revamped Audio.

And much more!

I hope you all enjoy this update. Go find those kids, Officer.
